title: Read-only Codex delegations on Windows: MSYS sh.exe dies (CreateFileMapping error 5) yet reports exit 0, and Node spawnSync returns EPERM
outcome: In a read-only Codex delegation on Windows, commands that need the Git for Windows POSIX shell or a Node child process either run, or fail visibly with a non-zero exit that names the sandbox as the cause. A fatal shell crash is never reported as exit 0, so a read-only reviewer cannot mistake a crashed command for a real result.
acceptance: Read-only Codex delegations on Windows: MSYS sh.exe dies (CreateFileMapping error 5) yet reports exit 0, and Node spawnSync returns EPERM is done
